title: docs(curriculum): align Day01 Node version
body:
## BLUF

Day01 curriculum and the scaffold script now match the app runtime requirement: Node.js 22+ instead of Node.js 20+. This is a bounded #110 blocker removal only; it does not close #110.

## Evidence

- Cloud task: https://chatgpt.com/codex/tasks/task_e_6a14da18c46883318e691a07c36412d8
- Diff: `material/30days-curriculum/day01_開発環境を整えて、初めてのアプリを動かそう.md` changes the prerequisite and expected `node -v` output from 20 to 22.
- Diff: `scripts/scaffold-from-scratch.sh` now rejects Node.js < 22 and shows Node 22 guidance, keeping the executable setup path aligned with Day01 and `package.json`.
- Local env: `node -v` = v25.7.0, `npm -v` = 11.10.1.
- `bash -n scripts/scaffold-from-scratch.sh`: pass.
- `rg 'Node\\.js 20|v20\\.x|Node\\.js 22|v22\\.x|"node": ">=22"' ...`: no Node 20 curriculum/scaffold prerequisite remains; Node 22 appears in Day01, scaffold, and `package.json`.
- `npm test`: failed because test database is not reachable at `localhost:5436` (`Prisma P1001`). This is environment setup, not caused by the doc-only curriculum change.

## Sales-quality impact

Day01 no longer tells buyers to use a Node version lower than `package.json` requires, reducing first-lesson setup confusion.

## Scope and risk

- Files intentionally touched: Day01 curriculum markdown and `scripts/scaffold-from-scratch.sh`.
- Files intentionally not touched: app code, auth, DB/schema, payment/price/public URL, LP, #108/#109/#113 areas.
- Security: no credentials, env dumps, screenshots, external URLs, or auth changes.
- Backward compatibility: documentation-only change; existing routes/data/auth/session unaffected.
- Rollback: revert this single commit if needed.

## #110 status

References #110. Full #110 remains open until fresh `/tmp/task-app-fresh-loop` Day01->Day30 zero-fix run passes with per-day `npm run build`, `npm test`, Playwright screen match, and `.planning/loop-3/` evidence.
